title: RepoAssure Representative Multi-Mode Acceptance Target Readiness and Acquisition Authorization Package v0.1
objective: Prepare lane-scoped target readiness and acquisition authorization material for the deferred Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent representative acceptance lanes without acquiring or executing any target.
acceptance: Prepare one candidate readiness card for each of Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent with intended source, ownership, license-review plan, revision-pinning plan, privacy and secret review plan, reproducibility prerequisites, command envelope draft, isolation boundary, allowed outputs, stop conditions, and cleanup plan.
Separate target-readiness evidence from any future target acquisition or execution authorization.
Keep every lane deferred until a later explicit maintainer decision names an exact target revision or digest and bounded action envelope.
Do not acquire, clone, install, start, analyze, execute, or write any target.
Do not publish, deploy, launch, modify repository controls, contact anyone, change pricing or spend, change detector or acceptance behavior, or infer final product acceptance.
